document_name: Existing FAA Part 107 Regulations & Airspace Rules
description: Raw text of current Federal Aviation Administration regulations regarding commercial drone operations. Essential for validating flight envelopes and compliance requirements.
recency_requirement: Current regulations in effect (must verify latest amendments)
steps_to_find: Access FAA.gov UAS (Unmanned Aircraft Systems) section
Download Part 107 Subpart E documentation for operations over people
Review LAANC authorization guidelines and Class B airspace restrictions

document_name: Atlanta/Dallas/Pittsburgh Zoning Ordinances for Industrial Entertainment Use
description: Local government zoning laws and codes specific to the target cities. Required to verify if commercial drone operations and entertainment venues are permitted in industrial zones.
recency_requirement: Current local ordinances (published within last 12 months)
steps_to_find: Search municipal planning department websites for each city
Review industrial zone classification codes in zoning maps
Contact local zoning boards to confirm variance requirements

document_name: Local Building Codes & HVAC Safety Regulations for Warehouses

Verify fire suppression standards for high-density occupancy areas
